And that's only half of the fish belly tray's worth of rice cakes... Haha, half of them were newly delivered, and half of them seem to have been refrigerated two weeks ago. And the meat stew has a strong fishy smell, and judging from the fact that none of the menus in this restaurant use fish as a main ingredient, it seems like they either kept it in the same refrigerator as the fish that they eat at the store, or they outsource the meat stew... Although the overall taste of the food was satisfactory, it is too ambiguous to give it a high star rating because the management of the freshness of the ingredients was so bad... I don't want to eat spoiled food after paying 70,000 won, so I'm holding off on a return visit indefinitely. It looks like we will have to keep our distance from Gyeong-Ok for a few more years even after the pandemic passes.

Daewoo Budae Jjigae
This is a family with quite a bit of business in this neighborhood, spanning two generations.
I run a successful restaurant.

I usually eat all kinds of unhealthy processed meats such as Spam, Corn King, and Tulip.
As a person who loves... of course, I can't hate Budae Jjigae... so after boiling and boiling the processed meat according to the age, I throw it away.
I used to enjoy it

The Daewoo Budae Jjigae we received after ordering for two people had no cheese, so the broth was clean.

Processed meats such as corn king and tulip ham are delicious, but the minced meat under the broth adds a chewy taste, so when you mix it over rice and eat it, the bowl of rice is gone before you know it.

Suwon Lee Na-kyung, Songtan Choi Ne, Kim Ne...

I had many good memories at the viewing point, so I went there with high expectations, but it ended up being a disappointing meal.
The taste itself was maintained to some extent, but the attentive service that was quite impressive at the city hall was nowhere to be found.
In particular, due to the lack of skill in grilling meat, the meat was overly burned or the level of doneness varied, disrupting the flow of meals.

My former coworkers who went with me said, “But the meat tastes good,” which put me off for a bit, but the various details made me think, “I don’t think I’ll come next time.”
The quality of the pork belly itself that I ordered in the three-person set wasn't bad, but it was frustrating to see more and more burnt marks on the meat.
In addition, I had low expectations for the stew and side menu items at the City Hall branch, but they were not much different at the Gangnam branch, and the taste was so disappointing that I almost didn't try it.

The pork neck was quite thick and nice, with a steak feel to it, but the grilling skill didn't bring out the full flavor.
You have to be careful, as the texture and taste can change dramatically even if you cook it just a little, but it gave the impression that the staff cooked it in a hurry.

Also, I wonder why the sigh that was heard every time I asked a question about ordering came out so often.
Was it really that inconvenient to add meat for the 6th time between the three of us? It was quite unpleasant.

The meat itself is definitely good, but there are plenty of pork restaurants of this quality in Gangnam.
From the service to the detailed baking skills, I had the impression that the overall strengths of the viewing store were not utilized at all, so there was no reason to revisit.
Next time, it seems wiser to just go to the city hall or choose another pork belly restaurant.

reviews.text:
The neck pork was so delicious that I want to come back!!
The owner is friendly and the overall atmosphere is good.

It was recommended that I order a set menu so I could enjoy a variety of dishes, so I ordered a set for 3 people.
I think it was because I ate a little too much, but they also gave me yellow radish as a service and it was fun.

And although I couldn't eat the birthday cake, I could light candles and celebrate, so I had a fun birthday party.
Oh, by the way, you have to refrigerate the cake.
Thank you very much. I enjoyed it :)

reviews.author: Jungtae Kim
reviews.text: It's my first time eating meat from the spicy pork breed and it's really delicious. They give you a variety of sauces so you can choose from them, and it was nice that they grilled it for you and gave you a piece with a description of the part and a recommended sauce! Cold noodles and other side dishes are also delicious~

reviews.author: Jeongmin Oh
reviews.text:
I visited Yeoksam because it is famous for its meat restaurants!
This is my first time hearing about naanchukmatdon, but it was definitely chewier and more delicious👍
There were a variety of side dishes and self-refills were available, so it was plentiful.
It was so convenient because they also grilled the meat!!
The two of us ate set A with cheonggukjang rice and it was just right to fill up.

reviews.author: fat
reviews.text:
A hidden restaurant in Gangnam Station and Yeoksam Station!!!Maddon Livestock~~! I think this restaurant found a pearl in the dirt... ㅜㅜI had the Matdon A set and it was a special assorted set! You grill the meat yourself and eat it with various sauces, so you can taste new flavors every time you eat it.
The light and savory flavor spreads in your mouth~ This is my first time eating special pork cuts (under the chin, thigh meat, tail meat, etc.) and they are soft and melt like beef. If you are looking for a company dinner or group gathering near Gangnam Station, I recommend Matdon Livestock ♥️♥️♥️

reviews.author: Erina Lee
reviews.text:
First of all, the quality of the meat is amazing. From Matdon Livestock’s special sauce to the meat, it’s really delicious!
It's close to my house, so I came here to eat with my husband, and there are a lot of places to have company dinners, and it was really delicious. Definitely try real cold noodles. Dongchimi is truly the best I’ve ever eaten.

reviews.author: Jaewon Park
reviews.text: It’s been a while since I ate delicious pork! I was able to eat it comfortably as they explained it to me one by one. I feel like they paid more attention to the surrounding sauces than anything else to the juicy taste of the meat. The top-down duct prevents the smell of meat from permeating, so it’s also recommended as a meeting place!

reviews.author: VLADY
reviews.text: This is Yukmidang Mongsan, a restaurant near Gangnam Station. The charcoal fire in the brazier is so good that the meat is grilled quite deliciously. The couple set is really cost-effective. Since it is a corkage-free establishment, you can bring your own wine and enjoy it. The store is spacious, so it would be great for company dinners and wine gatherings.

reviews.author: KEVIN YUN
reviews.text: I found this place while looking for a meat restaurant at Gangnam Station, and the prices were crazy. 3 people ate a 3-piece set of beef, and the quality of the meat was good. When grilled on charcoal, the charcoal scent was absorbed and the flavor of the meat was much better. The water-naeng and non-naeng soybean paste stew I ate for dessert was delicious, and the raw meat I received as a service was also really delicious. Next time, I'll try the Korean pork set as well.

reviews.author: Ho Jung Lee
reviews.text:
I think this is the best value for money among the meat restaurants around Gangnam Station. In particular, the rib meat is well-aged, so it has no unpleasant odour, is soft, and has a meaty flavor. The marbled ssam is also the right size and thickness, so it is very delicious. I highly recommend it if you focus on meat more than anything else.

Charcoal also has good heating power and quality, so it does not harm the grilling or taste of meat. The servers are very friendly and if you feel like you're missing anything, they provide it to you in advance. In the meantime, I will definitely visit again next time as they kindly set it up without a cork charge.

reviews.author: Eric Kang
reviews.text:
3 adults went, but the seats were narrow and uncomfortable.
The food is okay, but the stove is high so it's uncomfortable to eat.
Also, since the side dishes are self-serve, it is not recommended if you feel uncomfortable moving around while eating. There are not many people, so you can eat quietly. I think it's a good place for two people to go.

reviews.author: training
reviews.text: The meat has a slight charcoal flavor and is delicious. A place where you can enjoy grilled meat with tongs^^! I like the side dishes as they are clean and there are no unnecessary items. It's the same meat, but it doesn't taste like this at home^^! Everything was perfect, including cold noodles and brisket soybean paste for dessert^^♡

address: 1st floor, 20 Gangnam-daero 96-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Geemail
reviews.text:
There's a new restaurant that opened in the location of Hanam Pork House, and they're having a lamb skewer event. The lamb skewers are served with a large piece of meat, so it tastes good. However, if you order skewers for two, you get 8 or 10 skewers.
Lamb skewers are delicious, but sometimes they don't cut well even when you chew them. The main dish is also delicious and the batter is not too thick. It's a bit salty, so I recommend adding rice to it. It feels clean and the servers are friendly.

reviews.author: Bamko
reviews.text:
The food was delicious, and it was easy to order through Kios at your seat.
However, it was disappointing that the response was not done immediately, perhaps because there were not enough staff compared to the number of guests.

reviews.author: Hyeonki Hong
reviews.text:
As of June 24, it appears to have been renamed Mokhyang.

We made a reservation for 5 people, but they forced us to eat on one grill. Even though 6 people were eating as one, they kept asking me why and noticing it, so we ate a lot quickly and said we would go without two grills, and only then did they give us two seats.
I would understand if there were more people, but there were only two teams including us.
Even though we sat at two tables, they only gave us one light until we ordered a lot of menu items.

reviews.author: Jun woong CHOI
reviews.text:
The actual taste is mediocre, but the staff is a bit strange.
What are you doing in front of the table when you turn on the fire too late and even light it with tongs? He was standing and spinning around with the lights on with an expression like this. If it had spilled, it would have been a really big problem. Most of the time it was ridiculous and I was a little scared because I kept laughing and the female staff member usually said unpleasant things to me and told me not to go.

reviews.author: Seung Wook Kim
reviews.text:
The mapo tofu was a bit salty.
Was it a water dumpling? Wow.. the celery in it was amazing.
Good
